description: Measures the tempo of a clock and gives back the rate voltages a Fundamental LFO, SEQ-3 and Delay expect, with three clock outputs of its own

params.text: Sets how much of each freshly measured beat length goes into the running tempo, 0 holding the tempo it already has and 1 replacing it outright
Sets how many pulses Clk2 Out gives per beat, a whole number from 1 to 8
Sets how many pulses Clk3 Out gives per beat, a whole number from 1 to 8
Scales the gap between the Clk2 Out pulses, 0 to 2 with 1 spacing them evenly, and the count restarts on every detected beat
Scales the gap between the Clk3 Out pulses, 0 to 2 with 1 spacing them evenly, and the count restarts on every detected beat
Multiplies the beat length by a whole number from 1 to 8 before the Delay CV voltage is worked out
Divides the beat length by a whole number from 1 to 8 before the Delay CV voltage is worked out

inputs.text: A clock whose beat length is measured from one rising edge to the next; the detected tempo in beats per minute shows on the display

outputs.text: A voltage tracking the detected tempo at one volt per doubling of the rate, for the FREQ input of a Fundamental LFO
A voltage three volts below the LFO one, for the CLOCK input of a Fundamental SEQ-3
A voltage setting a Fundamental Delay to the beat length after the multiplication and division, on a logarithmic scale from 0-10V
A 10ms pulse at 10V on every detected beat
A 10ms pulse at 10V, repeating within each beat at the count and spacing set for clock 2
A 10ms pulse at 10V, repeating within each beat at the count and spacing set for clock 3

notes: nothing is measured until a clock is patched to Clk In: with that jack empty the clock outputs give no pulses and the rate outputs hold the voltage last worked out
menu: Swing Range — Fine narrows both Swing knobs to a quarter of their travel around even spacing, and Legacy gives them their full 0 to 2 range

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
